  1401	13. Corvid Conspiracy C
  1402	13.1 Overview
  1403	The Corvid Conspiracy seeks to strong-arm the Wood­
  1404	land into submission by completing criminal plots,
  1405	scoring victory points each time they flip one. The more
  1406	revealed plots on the map, the more they score. Mis­
  1407	direction is critical—if their plans are too obvious, the
  1408	Corvids risk exposure. To avoid this, they must recruit
  1409	carefully and look for any opportunities for subterfuge
  1410	and extortion.
  1411	13.2 Faction Rules and Abilities
  1412	13.2.1     Crafting. The Corvids craft during Birdsong by
  1413	activating plot tokens (whether face up or down).
  1414	13.2.2     Plot Tokens. The Corvids have eight plot tokens,
  1415	two of each type.
  1416	I     Token Facing. While in the Corvids’ supply,
  1417	plot tokens are face down (feather). While on
  1418	the map, a plot token can be face up (unique
  1419	icon) or face down. The Corvids can inspect
  1420	any facedown plot token at any time.

  1493	14. Lord of the Hundreds H
  1494	14.1 Overview
  1495	The Lord of the Hundreds suffers no fools and allows
  1496	no dissent. During their Evening, they score points
  1497	based on how well they oppress their foes. The more
  1498	clearings they rule that have a Hundreds piece and no
  1499	enemy pieces—no warriors, no buildings, nothing—the
  1500	more points they score. To grow in power and attract
  1501	warriors, the Hundreds must gain items and add them
  1502	to their towering hoard. Leading the Hundreds is the
  1503	warlord, a warrior-demagogue whose fickle mood
  1504	gives them an ability for the turn. Their warlord is ob­
  1505	sessed with hoarding, so as the Hundreds gain more
  1506	items, they will have fewer moods to choose from. De­
  1507	claring themselves as the true voice of the Woodland,
  1508	the Hundreds can incite mobs, which destroy enemy
  1509	buildings and tokens, and raid ruins for items.

  1512	activating strongholds.
  1513	14.2.2     The Warlord. The Hundreds have a piece called
  1514	the warlord. The warlord is a warrior that cannot
  1515	be removed outside of battle, moved outside of
  1516	the Hundreds’ turn, or placed in ways other than
  1517	setup (14.3.2) and the Anoint action (14.4.3).
  1518	14.2.3     Contempt for Trade. Whenever the Hundreds
  1519	craft an item, they may take the item but score
  1520	none of the listed victory points, or may remove the
  1521	item permanently to score the listed victory points.
  1522	(They can still score extra crafting points from effects such
  1523	as Master Engravers and the Legendary Forge.)

  1525	Hundreds have the Hoard box. This has two
  1526	tracks, Command and Prowess. The Command
  1527	track can hold M, B, and X. The Prowess track
  1528	can hold H, T, S, and C.
